`abstract class RadarChartNode<DATA extends RadarChartData>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Node`](/reference/nodes/node/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.impl.chart` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [RadarChartNode.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/impl/chart/RadarChartNode.java)

Base class of a radar chart, which shows one value per axis around a center.

![A radar chart over four axes A, B, C and D](/captures/catalog-nodes-radarchartnode.webp)

## Description

A radar chart draws nothing by itself: a subclass draws its data.
It waits until it has at least three entries and every entry has a value, drawing its skeleton meanwhile.

## Learn more

- [Charts](/use/learn/going-further/charts/#draw-a-radar-chart)
